title: Commit: feat(arch): add complete layer architecture for the ecosystem
content:
feat(arch): add complete layer architecture for the ecosystem

Implements the owner's full layer architecture specification:
- 11 main layers (L0-L10) from Hardware through Applications
- 8 cross-cutting layers (X1-X8) for Security, Identity, Protocol,
  Data, Standards, Testing, Observability, and Build
- 51 sub-layers with unique IDs
- 30 existing catalog components mapped to the new layer scheme
- Installation models A-D with fail-closed kernel-layer restrictions
- Catalog hierarchy levels 0-7 (layer to verification)
- Metadata schema fields for every catalog entry
- Binding status values (MAPPED/IMPLEMENTED/VERIFIED/RESIDUAL/
  UNRESOLVED/BLOCKED/EXCLUDED) with fail-closed evidence rules
- 10 validation rules (VAL-LR-001 through VAL-LR-010)

New files:
- docs/architecture/layers/ATC-LAYER-REGISTRY-001.yaml (SSOT for layers)
- docs/architecture/layers/ATC-LAYER-MAPPING-001.yaml (component mapping)
- docs/architecture/ATC-ECOSYSTEM-LAYER-ARCHITECTURE-001.md (spec doc)
- tools/validate_layer_registry.py (fail-closed validator)

The old flat 'layer' field in the catalog (L0-L7 with different
semantics) is superseded by this mapping. Migration traceability is
preserved via the old_layer field in each mapping entry.
